text:
li: Heads up - mobile SDKs started failing with streaming since the v5 framing switch rolled to canary. Lots of disconnects reported.

rohan: reproable locally? any logs?

li: repro 100% on my phone emulator. The server now emits `chunked-json` frames instead of our old `ndjson` lines. Old SDKs parse line-by-line and hang when they see `{\"type\":\"frame\"}\n`.

li: example curl that works vs fails: 
```\n# new framing (works with latest runtime)\ncurl -N https://edge.redwood/stream -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'\n```

rohan: why did we change to chunked-json? I thought RFC said compatibility header would be required.

tereza: we added chunked-json to support enriched metadata per-frame and binary blobs. RFC included opt-in header `X-Stream-Mode: chunked-json` but ingress removed default fallback and some clients didn't send header.

infra-bot: infra-bot: deploy of stream-runtime v5 -> canary 20% at 2024-10-01T02:00Z.

li: impact: mobile SDKs (<=3.4) don't send header and fail to parse. Desktop clients ok.

rohan: short-term mitigation idea: ingress shim that detects old-line-delimited frames and translates to chunked-json when upstream expects it, and also allow runtime to fall back to ndjson when header absent. Which side should be responsible?

tereza: I'd prefer ingress shim for two reasons: 1) avoids changing runtimes mid-release, 2) we can feature-flag it per-tenant and rate-limit conversions. Long-term: require explicit `X-Stream-Mode` in API contract and bump SDKs.

li: agreed. ingress shim plan: when header missing and payload content matches ndjson pattern (newline-delimited json objects), set internal header `x-stream-compat: ndjson` and rewrite frames into chunked-json envelopes for runtime. Also mirror `X-Stream-Mode` back to raw header for older proxies.

rohan: telemetry: emit `stream.compat.rewrite` with count and tenant. Make it low-cardinality and sample 1/100 to avoid flood.

tereza: owners? rohan -> implement ingress matcher + rewrite. li -> coordinate mobile SDK patch and opt-in client release. anya -> customer comms + console banner.

li: mobile SDK release will add header by default and try to detect server support; fallback to `ndjson` if server returns 415. I'll ship a patch tomorrow.

rohan: rollout: enable shim feature-flag on canary for 48h, monitor `infra.stream.disconnects.mobile` and `stream.compat.rewrite`. If rewrite rate >1% for a tenant, notify support-runbook.

tereza: also add a tiny integration test: ingest ndjson input at ingress and ensure runtime receives chunked-json. unit tests + e2e in canary pipeline.

anya: add this to the streaming-framing RFC follow-up: mandate explicit `X-Stream-Mode` by next major, add deprecation timeline for implicit ndjson.

li: thanks all. I'll open the SDK PR and link here.

rohan: opening ingress PR now.
